Meta.title: ONEBODY — Meant to be ONE
Meta.description: Global donation platform of the ONEBODY Foundation. We build homes, feed families, and sustain communities in the Dominican Republic. Many members, one body.

Hero.subtitle: Every donation is a point that converges. Together we form something whole: homes, food, education, and hope for real families.

Foundation.heading: We are laying the groundwork
Foundation.body: This is the technical foundation of the ONEBODY platform: secure, fast, and ready to grow. The projects, donations, and impact modules arrive in the coming iterations.
Foundation.tagline: Meant to be ONE · Diseñados para ser UNO

Landing.how1b: A project or the general fund.
Landing.how3b: Every gift brings the goal closer until it's met.
Landing.impact25: feeds a family for a week
Landing.impact50: covers a child's school supplies for a month
Landing.impact100: provides materials for a section of a house
Landing.impact250: supports a single mother for a month
Landing.wallEmpty: Be the first to appear here.
Landing.closingBody: Your gift converges with thousands. Together we form one body.
